translations.changes: Amudi escaped HTML and divided existing source text into reading sections of at most 900 words before loading, preserving every source word in order. These are Amudi reading divisions, not canonical simanim or printed dapim. Amudi performed no OCR or translation. Copyrightable adaptations remain CC BY-SA 4.0.
translations.coverageStatus: All 91 supplied source text files, numbered 2–92, including the author and publisher introductions through the concluding Hadran of Asarah Yuchasin and tractate Kiddushin. Source file numbers are edition file coordinates, not Gemara dapim. This is the provider edition, not a claim of collation against every historical witness. Existing automatically digitized text was sampled for identity and coherence, not proofread word by word. No English translation is included.
